spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the exact product situation the option exists for — href on the allowlist, javascript: hrefs still stripped — on both the safe path and the newly expressible unsafe + javascriptURLs:false path.

interactive.rationale: Path selector, user-supplied hostile comment input, and a render button that performs real setHTML/setHTMLUnsafe calls and audits every surviving link's parsed scheme.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises hostile comments rendered with links allowed and every surviving link audited; the feed does exactly that, including the what-not-to-ship permissive mode.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes an obfuscated uppercase/whitespace spelling, an entity-encoded user example, the permissive unsafe-default mode (clicks on surviving javascript: links are blocked inside the demo), and plain-text rendering when the sanitizer is absent or ignores the option.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5169798320357376, the HTML Standard anchor and MDN.

conformance.rationale: The two productive paths correspond to the suite's safe-sethtml-strips-javascript-href and unsafe-optin-strips-with-sanitizer-proof assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP): rendered on the safe path and the unsafe-strict path at 1280×800 and 360×740; comments displayed as plain text with the real exception per card and the honest no-API verdict; zero console errors / failed requests; an initial 678px mobile overflow from the long select options was found and fixed (select width + overflow-wrap), then re-measured at 0px on both classes; screenshots re-read after the fix. DOWNGRADED pass→partial (review finding, 2026-10-18): Chromium 141 lacks the Sanitizer API, so only the fallback/exception branch executed — the supported-path primary interaction (real sanitization output on a Sanitizer-enabled build) remains unverified, and fallback-only verification is partial by this rubric’s own standard. Re-run on Chrome 146+/157 to upgrade.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts sanitizer-feed-rendered with path/link counts and sanitizer-feed-absent-branch on the no-API branch.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; link audit uses accent-emerald-dark/accent-rose on stone; buttons pair background and color.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select and textarea, aria-live verdict and feed region, per-comment link audit as text (not colour-only), focus-visible outlines.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Re-verified after the overflow fix: 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; select now spans the container and comment bodies wrap anywhere.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the three paths on a 157 build and screenshot the audits
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 only the plain-text no-API branch runs. On Chrome 157, verify: safe path keeps the two https links and strips both javascript: hrefs; unsafe-strict does the same while keeping the HTML comment and data-track attribute; unsafe-default surfaces the surviving javascript: links with the warning verdict.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML safely setHTML Sanitizer API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Allow only needed elements/attributes; load a library fallback only when native support is missing; plain text is the safe floor.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The safe path uses a tight allowlist with href; without any sanitizer the page renders comments as textContent — the guidance's DOMPurify fallback is cited in prose rather than shipped, as the showcase demonstrates the platform surface.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: setHTML() needs no Trusted Types policy; unsafe sinks under enforcement do.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Documented in the 'why the unsafe path at all?' section tying the option to Trusted Types deployments.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Constrain replaced/form controls to the container and wrap long unbroken strings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fixed in place after measurement: select { width:100% }, overflow-wrap:anywhere on comment bodies; re-measured 0px overflow.

summary: The practical angle: a comment feed that allowlists href and still must never ship a javascript: link, rendered through the real API on three selectable paths with a per-link scheme audit. Verified honestly on Chromium 141 (plain-text fallback with real exceptions) at both viewport classes after fixing a mobile overflow found during verification.
